meta.description: Base layers of the Freight World map, drawn in our own style (no game files). Coordinates are projected x/y in kilometres (equirectangular at 36.5°N, origin 116.5°W 36.5°N). Roads are real-world highways of the states in scope; the in-game road network may differ, and a few local roads are missing at this scale (e.g. AZ-95 through Lake Havasu City), where routes join the nearest road with a short straight link.
